name: Fund Guy Skill
tagline: A humorous 'fund guy' screening skill for agents
description: Fund Guy Skill is an agent skill built around the humorous "fund guy" (基佬) meme from Chinese internet culture, turning the running joke into a playful screening routine. It is less a serious analytical tool and more a dispatchable personality — an agent skill that responds in the exaggerated, overconfident voice of the meme when asked to screen or evaluate. It is a lighthearted example of how meme culture is now being packaged as reusable agent skills.
highlights: Turns the 'fund guy' (基佬) meme into a reusable agent skill
Packages a playful, overconfident screening persona for agents
A lighthearted sign of meme culture entering the agent-skill ecosystem
Fun to prompt and a glimpse at how personality is being productized
curatorNote: Most of the agent-skill ecosystem is serious tooling, so it is refreshing to see someone ship a meme as a skill. Fund Guy Skill is pure internet-culture energy — and a reminder that agent skills can be fun too.
